content:
jane_support: FYI customer Acme Media says AWS accelerator credits not showing in their account balance (case #C-2026-987). They see a grant in partner portal but nothing in Redwood billing. Order ID: ord-98765, tenant: tenant-acme-001. Can billing/eng take a look? :eyes:

alex_billing: Looking. Can you paste the entitlement webhook payload they received? Also which Redwood account ID did they sign up with?

jane_support: They sent the webhook JSON and their Redwood account is acct-1234. Webhook looks like this in their logs:
```json
{"entitlement_id":"ent-555","order_id":"ord-98765","status":"GRANTED","customer_account":"acct-7890","product_code":"redwood-accelerator","granted_units":5000}
```
They claim acct-7890 is an old linked org from the partner side.

alex_billing: Ah — webhook target is acct-7890 not acct-1234. That explains why credits landed on a different org. I'll check mapping service to see why partner mapping resolved to the legacy org. :thinking_face:

priya_eng: On it. Two quick checks: 1) confirm entitlement->account resolution table for order ord-98765; 2) check the async webhook retry queue. Could be a stale linkage in partner-mapping cache.

aws-marketplace-bot: [system] webhook received for ord-98765 at 2026-04-10T12:14:03Z, status=GRANTED, delivered=true

priya_eng: I queried the mapping DB: result shows mapping(order=ord-98765) => acct-7890 (linked_org_id: org-legacy-22). There was a manual merge in 2025 that created a shadow mapping; cache ttl was 30d and wasn't invalidated. Repro steps I ran:
```
# repro (internal):
curl -s -X GET "https://internal.redwood/api/v1/mappings?order=ord-98765" -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAFF_TOKEN" | jq
# shows mapping -> acct-7890
```

sam_ops: I can reassign. Plan: 1) requeue entitlement reconciliation for ord-98765 to acct-1234, 2) run mapping cleanup job for org-legacy-22, 3) invalidate partner-mapping cache. I'll run step 1 now.

sam_ops: Ran: `./scripts/entitlement-requeue --order ord-98765 --target-account acct-1234` — job returned 0 and created job id j-4421. Watching logs.

sam_ops: Worker processed j-4421, applied 5000 credits to acct-1234, billing ledger entries created (txn tx-20260410-4421). Patch: cleared stale mapping and set mapping TTL=0 for org-legacy-22. :thumbsup:

alex_billing: Confirmed credits now show on acct-1234 balance and customer portal. I can see ledger tx-20260410-4421 and the usage delta. I'll mark the case as resolved once Jane confirms with the customer.

jane_support: Thanks team. I'll update the customer and close the loop. Also adding a short postmortem note to knowledge base about partner mapping cache invalidation.

priya_eng: Suggestion for follow-up: add a retry validator that compares webhook.customer_account with partner-mappings at delivery time and flag mismatches for human review.

jane_support: Good idea. Noted. Closing in the case after customer ACK. :white_check_mark:
